name: LACK
title: Side table

steps.caption: Top, face down
steps.say: Lay the tabletop face down on a rug or the flattened box, so the good side stays scratch free.

steps.caption: Twist in 4 screws
steps.say: Find the four holes near the corners. Twist a double ended screw into each one, about halfway, by hand.

steps.caption: Spin on 2 legs
steps.say: Grab a leg, line it up with a screw, and spin it clockwise until it sits snug. Do the same with a second leg.

steps.caption: Spin on 2 more
steps.say: Now the last two legs. Hand tight is perfect. No tools needed.

steps.caption: Flip it!
steps.say: Flip the table onto its legs. Give it a little wiggle. If a leg feels loose, give it one more turn.

done: That's it. Your table is done. Go put something nice on it.
